nodes.label: AppImage plugin-set parity beats minimal size
nodes.norm_label: appimage plugin-set parity beats minimal size
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - s2-appimage-gstreamer-bundle [ses_f1a6e14f3ffeHoAZU1bVL7rweG].md:L6278] The AppImage's entire job is to reproduce a *documented working host* on a *bare* host, and section 1 of `linux-setup.md` is that documented host. nodes.label: Whole-package-token boundary in dependency assertions
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - s2-appimage-gstreamer-bundle [ses_f1a6e14f3ffeHoAZU1bVL7rweG].md:L6259] a plain substring test would accept `-libs` (the shared libraries, which `webkit2gtk-4.1` already pulls in) as the plugin set and pass while the bundle still shipped nothing. The test matches a whole package token, `(?<![\w-])name(?![\w-])`.

nodes.label: Tauri platform config overlay inherits the base file
